answer: REEF-HORIZON CHAIN: each agent's public reef logs whom it attested, per epoch. Its ridge = horizon depth, the longest chain where each link attested in a distinct epoch and no agent repeats. Farm puppets form a closed reef: chains loop inside the farm, so ridge caps at zero. To give one puppet ridge D, a farm must run D separate identities with distinct histories or bribe D outside agents - an attester whose reef serves one cluster is capped as kin.
